stemMd: A DNA template strand is read in the direction 3-prime TACGGA 5-prime. What RNA sequence is produced, written 5-prime to 3-prime?
explanationMd: RNA is complementary and antiparallel to the template. Pair T with A, A with U, C with G and G with C while synthesising 5-prime to 3-prime, giving AUGCCU.

distractorRationale.e: This uses DNA thymine instead of RNA uracil.
distractorRationale.d: This reverses the correct orientation improperly.
distractorRationale.b: This substitutes uracil without complementary pairing.
distractorRationale.a: This repeats the DNA template and retains thymine.
